title: Day and Trial Passes: basis for the membership-conversion credit
content:
This document states the basis on which converting a Day and Trial Passes pass (Single Day Pass, Three-Day Trial Pass, Seven-Day Trial Pass, Weekly Visitor Pass, Monthly Trial Pass, Corporate Guest Pass) into a club membership earns a bill credit toward the new membership's enrollment fee.

## Rule
Converting to a club membership within the tier's conversion window, counted from when the pass was purchased, earns that tier's conversion credit toward the new membership's enrollment fee. The window is counted as full calendar days from the purchase date, with no partial-day rounding; the conversion must occur no later than the purchase date plus that many calendar days, and a conversion occurring exactly on that day still qualifies, since the boundary is inclusive.

## Eligibility checklist
- What is checked: the company's own current record of the date the pass was purchased, correlated to the same pass being converted.
- When it is checked: before the conversion's credit is applied.
- Timing rule: the moment of conversion must not be later than the purchase date plus the tier's conversion window in full calendar days; a conversion occurring exactly on that final day still qualifies (the boundary is inclusive), and a conversion on any later day does not earn the credit.

### Boundary illustration (hypothetical)
For any tier, take the purchase date as the anchor and the tier's own conversion window in calendar days as the allowed span. A conversion completed on the last calendar day of that window still earns the credit. A conversion completed on the calendar day immediately after that window closes does not earn the credit.
